requestedOutcome: Reduce repeated reasoning around several concurrent deterministic PRs by selecting at most one exact next platform-review candidate and typing every refresh or evidence hold.
cheapestHonestRoute: Add a separate read-only adapter that composes existing checkpoint and publisher handoffs with host-authenticated GitHub reads; do not expand the network-writing publisher or add merge authority.

newHand.purpose: Bind an ordered PR set to current main, exact heads, handoff evidence, named checks, and GitHub receiver state, then emit zero or one next action.
side_effects: read current GitHub main and pull-request state
optional explicit create-new output outside repository
newHand.resource_budget: One main-ref read, one bounded open-PR inventory, targeted reads only for declared candidates absent from that inventory, and local deterministic computation.
newHand.failure_and_recovery: Hold with typed evidence; never skip a blocked predecessor or mutate GitHub. Discard every plan after any external action and reprobe.
newHand.compatibility_version_contract: Consumes checkpoint/platform handoff v1 and GitHub CLI JSON fields; emits sequencer v0.1 packets.
newHand.verification_contract: Pure deterministic cases, drift and authority refusals, mocked GitHub command trace, real read-only plan over all current open PRs, and full Workshop regression.
newHand.promotion_gate: Remain EXPERIMENTAL; technical NEXT_READY is not review acceptance, merge authority, promotion, roots, or CANON.
